about.title: Opuscula
paragraphs: Opusculum is Latin for a small work; opuscula is its plural. The name suits pieces that may be modest in extent without being casual in their preparation.
Every entry preserves its sources and distinguishes reproduction, translation, and revision wherever those differences matter.
